verdict.rationale: Ultrametric states it "runs no model" and relies on the user's own AI plan. Its assessment guides, templates and record stores feed the user's external agent, which does the reasoning; the product itself does not generate insights from user data. Agent-side analysis is a user-side, host-agent capability and earns no credit here, so this applicable axis has no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
